title: GEC Marconi scientist deaths during Star Wars/SDI era

tellings.quote: Between 1982 and 1990, 25 engineers and computer scientists, all working for GEC Maronei on some of Britain's most classified defense projects, all died one after [music] another.

plain: Between 1982 and 1990, Michels says, 25 engineers and computer scientists died one after another, all of them working for GEC Marconi, a British defence firm, on some of Britain's most secret military projects. The deaths fell during the years of America's "Star Wars" missile defence plan. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about top scientists going missing, as an earlier pattern that might echo today's.
